content:
BUILT CoLAB recently participated in the 4th year of the 4th year of the Integrated Master in Architecture of the School of Technology and Architecture of ISCTE.

This was an opportunity for the BUILT CoLAB BIM Intelligence team, represented by António Aguiar Costa, Luís Sanhudo, Nycolas Glerean, Sofia Feist, Vítor Cardoso, Pedro Nogueira Martins and Pedro Ferreira, to share with students and future professionals their developments in the scope of the work that has been carried out aiming the digitalization of the AEC sector.

Invited by Ricardo Pontes Resende, responsible for the subject, BUILT CoLAB showed the architecture students the digital tools developed and tested so far, identifying their essential role in dematerialization and optimization of Construction processes.

For this, the team presented software that it has been developing with several specific functionalities, from the quick determination of a building’s modularisation potential to the visualisation of BIM models in a virtual and interactive environment.

For more information on the work that has been developed consult our Projects page.
